hints.phonology: Select 漢字 for char search, 調值 for tone search, 聲母/韻母/聲調 for MC or phoneme search, or use 詞彙 / custom category
hints.feature: For char search: specific character (e.g. 好). For tone search: tone class (e.g. 陰平). For MC search: query term like 幫/流摄. For phoneme search: identifier like p/a
hints.value: Pronunciation e.g. ɐu, tone value e.g. 55, MC search value e.g. ou/ts, phoneme search distribution e.g. 假攝
hints.warning: The Category + Comparative Feature combination determines which search scenario the data appears in. Wrong combinations still save data, but it won't render on the map in query flows — it can only be viewed by clicking into cards on the current page.
